## Vesta v1.1.7

### Detection notice

Current reports indicate that VACnet / VAC Live can detect Aimbot, RCS and Triggerbot use and issue cooldowns. No FPS setting, play style or feature configuration guarantees protection. The reliable way to avoid a cheat-related cooldown is not to play with cheats. Vesta makes no claim of immunity from cooldowns or bans.

### Changes

- Fixed Auto Accept after the game update: the button position and visibility now use Panorama layout offsets decoded from the running client instead of stale hard-coded offsets. The feature was confirmed working in-game after the fix.
- Synchronized the public source tree with the tested v1.1.7 build.
- Updated game-data readers, seed-trigger timing and recoil calculations after game changes. Seed-trigger accuracy still depends on live game timing and is not guaranteed.
- Removed outdated anti-cheat avoidance advice from the README and forum release text.

### Files and verification

The downloadable executable is built from this tag by GitHub Actions. The release contains SHA256SUMS and signed build provenance for the GitHub-hosted executable. The separate forum archive contains one vesta.exe from the locally tested build.
